summary.what_it_is: Astryx is an open-source design system from Meta with 150+ accessible React components, theming, dark mode, templates, and a CLI. It works with React 19+ and StyleX, and is designed for both human developers and AI assistants.
summary.why_trending: The project highlights being built for how teams build now — by people and AI agents together — and is currently in beta after powering 13,000+ apps internally at Meta for eight years.
summary.who_its_for: React developers and teams who want a fully customizable, no-lock-in design system that works with AI coding assistants.
